readout_other: Resting-state fMRI connectivity after TUS; three-option probabilistic reward choice task (counterfactual switching)
direction_notes: ACC-TUS impaired translation of counterfactual choice values into behavioural switching and altered ACC connectivity (increased within-ACC correlation, reduced correlation with other regions); lOFC-TUS had no such effect.

timing.protocol_description: 30 ms bursts of 250 kHz ultrasound generated every 100 ms; the stimulation lasted 40 s overall, applied immediately before testing (or before rs-fMRI).

source_quotes.n_subjects: Four healthy male rhesus monkeys (Macaca mulatta) were involved in the experiment.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: In two of the four macaques, the same stimulation was applied to the ACC using MRI-guided frameless stereotaxy19,33 immediately before nine testing sessions that were interleaved, across days, with nine control sessions in which no TUS was applied (Fig. 5a and Supplementary Fig. 4; Methods).
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: The ultrasound wave frequency was set to the 250 kHz resonance frequency and 30 ms bursts of ultrasound were generated every 100 ms with a digital function generator (Handyscope HS5, TiePie Engineering).
source_quotes.exposures[0].free_field.pressure_kpa: Voltage values per session ranged from 128 to 136 V and corresponded to a peak negative pressure of 1.152 to 1.292 MPa, respectively, measured in water with an in-house heterodyne interferometer (see ref.
source_quotes.exposures[0].in_situ.pressure_kpa: Based on a mean 66% transmission through the skull63, the estimated peak negative pressures applied ranged from 0.76 to 0.85 MPa at the target in the brain.
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.manufacturer: A single-element ultrasound transducer (H115-MR, diameter 64 mm, Sonic Concept) with a 51.74 mm focal depth was used with a coupling cone filled with degassed water and sealed with a latex membrane (Durex).

flags.reason: Four animals received TUS in total (two ACC and four lOFC); rs-fMRI TUS data from one animal; four animals contributed fMRI without TUS.
Nine ACC-TUS sessions in each of two animals; lOFC had 5 sessions per animal (4 animals x 5); ACC value recorded.
lOFC protocol stated to use the same design as ACC-TUS; parameters assumed identical because the paper describes one TUS protocol.
Derated by the authors using a mean 66% skull transmission from the literature, not measured in these animals; range reflects session voltages.
TUS described as disrupting ACC activity; effect direction on neural activity not clearly excitatory or inhibitory.
Behavioural testing in awake animals; rs-fMRI under isoflurane.
Day order described as pseudorandom, counterbalanced; sham sessions interleaved.
